claim: Monitoring Analytics estimated that existing and forecast data-centre load added $9.332 billion to 2025/2026 PJM auction revenues and that removing that load would have lowered the result by 63.5%.
shortLabel: PJM cost shift from data-centre load
comparisonContext: This primary-source estimate helps explain how local rate impacts can emerge from data-centre growth.
scopeNote: Auction-revenue impact estimate in PJM, not a household bill estimate by itself.
sourceTitle: Analysis of the 2025/2026 RPM Base Residual Auction: Part G (Revised)
